name: Measure-Theoretic Probability
summary: Probability rebuilt on measure theory: sigma-algebras, modes of convergence, conditional expectation, martingales and limit theorems.

topics.name: Probability spaces, sigma-algebras and random variables as measurable functions
Expectation as a Lebesgue integral; convergence theorems
Modes of convergence: almost sure, in probability, in Lp and in distribution
Characteristic functions and the central limit theorem
Discrete-time martingales: optional stopping and convergence theorems
Kolmogorov extension theorem and construction of Brownian motion
